decisions.reason: The firm publicly set up a new business unit for this offshore service, indicating substantial sunk investment and visible commitment, and with no reported negative results, escalation of commitment makes dropping unlikely.
It builds on the established offer and was given its own page, creating investment and public commitment, so absent clear failure the firm will likely persist.
The online portal leverages existing capabilities and was publicly presented, so sunk costs and justification pressure imply keeping it.
The mobile app also builds on the firm's offer and has public visibility, so escalation of commitment suggests persistence without evidence of sustained poor results.
